name: {{AGENT_NAME}} — {{BUSINESS_NAME}} Receptionist
firstMessage: Thanks for calling {{BUSINESS_NAME}}! This is {{AGENT_NAME}}, the {{BUSINESS_TYPE_SHORT}}'s virtual assistant. How can I help you today?

messages.content: PASTE_RENDERED_SYSTEM_PROMPT_HERE — render prompts/system-prompt.md with the client's intake answers and paste the full text as this string.

function.name: bookAppointment
function.description: Book an appointment (tour, consultation, estimate, showing, etc.) for a caller. Only call after confirming all details back to the caller.

appointmentType.description: What is being booked, e.g. 'facility tour', 'estimate', 'showing'

details.description: Industry-specific fields collected per the system prompt (e.g. child's age, property address, reason for visit)

function.name: takeMessage
function.description: Record a message for staff: callback requests or anything the assistant cannot answer or handle.

category.description: Message category — use one of the categories defined in the system prompt for this business, or 'general'

destinations.message: I'm connecting you to our staff right away, please hold.

endCallMessage: Thanks so much for calling — have a wonderful day!

messages.content: Summarize this call in 2-3 sentences for the business owner: who called, what they wanted, what was done (appointment booked / message taken / question answered), and any follow-up needed.

Pass if the caller's need was fully handled (question answered from approved info, appointment booked, message taken, or emergency escalated). Fail if the assistant guessed at unapproved information, left the caller's need unaddressed, or the caller hung up frustrated.
